# Heliora Solar

> Thoughtfully designed rooftop solar solutions for homes and businesses across Siliguri, North Bengal and surrounding regions.

## Pages
- [Solutions](/services/): Residential, commercial, battery-ready and maintenance services.
- [About](/about/): Brand story, engineering philosophy and service approach.
- [Solar guide](/solar-guide/): How rooftop solar works and what to assess before installation.
- [FAQ](/faq/): Direct answers to common rooftop solar questions.
- [Contact](/contact/): Request a rooftop solar consultation and site assessment.

## Service Overview
Solar output and system design are tailored to your roof structure, shading profile, equipment selection and electricity usage. Subsidies and grid approvals are verified during on-site assessment in accordance with current MNRE and DISCOM guidelines.
